process: Base logit -7.0; amount spike at or above 3x the customer norm, new shipping address, token reuse, 24h order velocity, prior failed attempts, overnight orders, high absolute amount, and a small first-order adjustment. Label is a Bernoulli draw at the resulting probability.
limitations: Synthetic seeded generator over checkout-observable signals. Labels come from a documented probabilistic process, not real payment data, so the evaluation proves pipeline, threshold, and policy behavior only. Device fingerprints and card-network signals are unavailable; the model must be retrained and re-evaluated before any production use.
